newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina sees jobless falling and 7.0 pct growth.
newsitem.headline: Argentina sees jobless falling and 7.0 pct growth.

text.p: Argentine unemployment data for May due to be announced on July 18 will show a drop of between 1.1-1.4 percentage points from last October's 17.3 percent, said a senior Economy Ministry official Thursday.
Carlos Rodriguez, chief consultant to Economy Minister Roque Fernandez, also said at a news conference that economic growth for this year looked set to reach seven percent.

Rodriguez said growth in the second quarter of this year should be about 8.0 percent "so annual growth could be around seven percent, just as President (Carlos) Menem has said -- he must have a crystal ball."
The official said some 200,000 jobs had been created between October last year and May this year and he predicted that a total of 400,000 jobs would be created in 1997.
